gen-audiowide-fs-rowan: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets its glyphs apart with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift. But Rowan, a literary serif with generous curve openings, softens the mood, so a slightly larger body size would suit it.
gen-audiowide-gf-bree-serif: Spaced-out tech tiles on top: Audiowide holds its line weight steady while Bree Serif below has outsized lowercase. Long text would read in a refined, literary voice.
gen-audiowide-gf-quando: Audiowide lays out its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, and holds one line width from start to finish. Make Quando large and its sparse spacing starts to sprawl.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biz-udmincho: BIZ UDMincho brings a shallow terminal curl and wide gaps, bookish and traditional, beneath the neon-tube strokes of Comfortaa. Smooth, unmodulated rounds up top meet quiet, low-contrast text below.
gen-comfortaa-gf-gentium-plus: Comfortaa draws every stroke with neon-tube consistency, and its spacing stretches out like an uncoiled spring. But Gentium Plus, a refined serif with pitcher-wide mouths on its c, rewards a slightly larger body size.
gen-comfortaa-gf-inika: Inika, classic and traditional, leaves a see-through gap in every s, sitting below the neon-tube strokes of Comfortaa. Steady pressure from first letter to last up top, subtle variation beneath.
gen-comfortaa-gf-rokkitt: Comfortaa spaces its ring-shaped c loosely, like an uncoiled spring. Rokkitt, bookish and traditional, brings a c as open as a bent paperclip beneath that plain, unmodulated outline.
gen-dafont-aaargh-fs-bespoke-slab: Aaargh comes in strong and commanding, its bowls and stems matching in weight with an open entry to the e. Bespoke Slab then grounds the page with lofty, refined lowercase.
gen-dafont-aaargh-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 gives dignified hairlines that stay visible without turning razor-thin, a counterpoint to the contrast-free strokes of Aaargh. Source Serif 4 then reads smoothly, its gaping c keeping lines open.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-rowan: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody a commanding, bloody swagger, while Rowan, literary and friendly, opens every curve generously. Bloody belongs up large, in brief bursts of just a few words.
